title.narrative: Support establishment of initiatives to protect and promote CLT Diversity

description.narrative: This initiative seeks to provide technical assistance in interventions that aim to protect and promote Mozambique’s cultural diversity towards the empowering youth and women through the creative economy. Technical support will be extended to support youth initiatives that highlight cultural heritage and foster innovation in the creative industries. A central component is the establishment of the UNESCO Creative Cities Network in Mozambique, strengthening international collaboration and positioning local cities as hubs of creativity. The activity will also focus on capacity building, equipping youth and women artists, as well as government officials, with skills in the digital economy and creative entrepreneurship. By enhancing digital literacy and entrepreneurial capacity, participants will be better prepared to leverage technology for cultural promotion, innovation, and sustainable growth. Ultimately, the initiative will contribute to inclusive development, empower marginalized groups, and ensure that Mozambique’s rich cultural diversity is preserved and celebrated as a driver of social cohesion and economic opportunity.
